description: Query Result Caching - Implement an in-memory query result cache with configurable expiration, manual/automatic cache invalidation on write operations, and integration via the interceptor pipeline.
steps: Create DBTools/Caching/IQueryCache.cs with interface: Get(string cacheKey) returning CacheEntry or null, Set(string cacheKey, object result, TimeSpan? expiration), Invalidate(string cacheKey), InvalidateByTable(string tableName), Clear(), GetStatistics() returning CacheStatistics.
Create DBTools/Caching/CacheEntry.cs with: Value (object), CreatedAt (DateTime), ExpiresAt (DateTime?), HitCount (int).
Create DBTools/Caching/CacheStatistics.cs with: TotalEntries (int), HitCount (long), MissCount (long), HitRate (double), EvictionCount (long).

Create DBTools/Caching/QueryCacheOptions.cs with: Enabled (bool, default false), DefaultExpiration (TimeSpan, default 5 minutes), MaxCacheSize (int, default 1000), EnableAutoInvalidation (bool, default true - automatically invalidates cache entries for a table when an Insert/Update/Delete hits that table).

Create DBTools/Caching/MemoryQueryCache.cs implementing IQueryCache: uses ConcurrentDictionary<string, CacheEntry> internally, handles expiration checks on Get, implements LRU eviction when MaxCacheSize is reached (track access time, evict oldest), thread-safe via ConcurrentDictionary.

Create DBTools/Caching/CacheKeyGenerator.cs with a static method GenerateKey(string sql, List<object> parameters) that creates a deterministic cache key from the SQL and parameters (using string concatenation + hash).

Create DBTools/Caching/CachingInterceptor.cs implementing both IQueryInterceptor and IAsyncQueryInterceptor: BeforeExecute checks cache for SELECT queries (generates key, checks IQueryCache.Get, if hit sets context.IsSuppressed = true and stores result in context.Properties['CachedResult']), AfterExecute stores results in cache for SELECT queries, and for Insert/Update/Delete calls InvalidateByTable if EnableAutoInvalidation is true.

Add QueryCacheOptions property to DbToolsOptions.cs: public QueryCacheOptions CacheOptions { get; set; } = new QueryCacheOptions(). Add ConfigureCaching(Action<QueryCacheOptions> configure) fluent method.
Register IQueryCache as singleton (MemoryQueryCache) and add CachingInterceptor in ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddDbTools() when CacheOptions.Enabled is true.

Modify AsyncSqlClient to check context.Properties for 'CachedResult' after interceptors suppress execution - if IsSuppressed and CachedResult exists, return the cached DataTable instead of an empty one.
Create DBToolsUnitTest/Caching/MemoryQueryCacheTests.cs testing: basic get/set, expiration, invalidation by key and table, max size eviction, statistics tracking.
Create DBToolsUnitTest/Caching/CacheKeyGeneratorTests.cs testing: same SQL+params produce same key, different SQL produces different key, null parameters handled.

Create DBToolsUnitTest/Caching/CachingInterceptorTests.cs testing: interceptor caches SELECT results, interceptor returns cached results on cache hit (sets IsSuppressed), interceptor invalidates on write operations.
acceptance_criteria: MemoryQueryCache implements thread-safe in-memory caching with expiration and eviction
CachingInterceptor transparently caches SELECT results and invalidates on writes
Cache is integrated via the existing interceptor pipeline (no changes to query execution flow needed beyond the IsSuppressed/CachedResult pattern)
AsyncSqlClient respects cached results when IsSuppressed is true
Configuration via QueryCacheOptions and DI registration
Unit tests verify cache hit/miss, expiration, eviction, auto-invalidation, and key generation
verification: Verify MemoryQueryCache uses ConcurrentDictionary for thread safety
Verify CachingInterceptor integrates with existing IQueryInterceptor interface without modification
Verify AsyncSqlClient changes are minimal and backward-compatible
Verify tests are comprehensive and follow MSTest patterns
findings: Implemented caching using ConcurrentDictionary from System.Collections.Concurrent and SHA256 from System.Security.Cryptography (both available in .NET 8 base library). The CachingInterceptor implements both IQueryInterceptor and IAsyncQueryInterceptor for full pipeline coverage. In ServiceCollectionExtensions, a single MemoryQueryCache instance is shared between the DI container registration and the CachingInterceptor to ensure cache consistency. The AsyncSqlClient changes are minimal: (1) check context.Properties for CachedResult when IsSuppressed, (2) store DataTable in context.Properties[QueryResult] before calling AfterExecute interceptors.
